plugins.name: nav
plugins.description: Keep any codebase navigable as it grows — audit (assess + feasibility + deep legacy sweep via domain fan-out), refactor (verbatim move + test gates), sync (file-top headers, plus the bilingual codebase map as its map leg), plan (spec → grounded plan), do (execute a small behaviour-changing change, disciplined, no artifact), compose (author/restructure a prose document as a deep module). Language-agnostic. Built on Ousterhout's deep-module principles (deep modules via information hiding).

plugins.name: shape
plugins.description: Forward motion: give intent its form via real disposable instances (not descriptions), record decisions legibly, and keep them current, then hand off to be built. Sibling to nav. Skills: mockup (render-to-decide), elicit (grounded grill → a thought, plus a survey leg that maps a decision space when a volley stalls), probe (a minimal experiment when nobody can settle a fork by argument), position (canon-authoring campaign → core docs), dogfood (use a built feature for real → friction + coverage gaps), align (decide next + render the plan), reconcile (prune stale notes), migrate (summon-only); doctor deferred. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: fathom
plugins.description: Fathom an unfamiliar repository — one skill, repo: climb a five-level comprehension ladder (Repository → Runtime → System → Behavior → Code) with one reconstruction-or-prediction gate per level, collapse rules for small repos, level-matched visual forms, and a persistent study cursor that resumes across sessions. The learner's predictive mental model is the deliverable. To fathom = to deeply understand; the root is the nautical depth unit, measured line by line downward. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: frame
plugins.description: Apply an explicit, named frame that forces a structure the default skips — to a problem (three reasoning lenses: first-principles, orthogonal, dialectic) or to an answer you already have (analogize — build a stress-tested analogy so it lands in plain language). Lenses feed shape one-way; analogize does not. Standalone. Renamed from think.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Reflect on your own working session — the one reflexive, cross-cutting family. Three summoned skills: catchup/park work the cursor, and retrace reconstructs a long development arc as evidence-backed causal stages before rendering a user-corrected interactive alignment artifact. A plain chronological recap remains skill-free. Read-only except each writer's bounded artifact. Cross-project, standalone.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Coordinate asynchronously through a verified GitHub workspace under the Accord memory model. Launch can remember the default workspace and initialize its PR-attested identity roster; report resolves the destination and recipient before Issue-default routing. Digest, reply, brief, and settle keep responsibility and memory on native GitHub state. Language-agnostic.
